$comment: REQ-EQP-005: refinement is a Safe Zone plus a Risk Zone. The safe zone always succeeds and is the reliable path everyone takes; the risk zone is a real decision with a real downside, which is the point (§22). Protection consumables let a player buy away the worst outcome, which is a gold sink (REQ-ECO-001).
$note: Refinement scales MAIN stats only. It never touches substats, so it cannot launder a badly-rolled item into a good one (REQ-EQP-002).

protection.$comment: A protection charge converts 'destroy' into 'downgrade' and 'downgrade' into 'nothing'. It never raises the success chance — the gamble stays a gamble.

costPerAttempt.$comment: Gold cost scales with the level being attempted and the item's level.
